claim_boundary: No cross-family sample-efficiency claim is permitted unless physical-cycle, calibration, and labeled-training budgets are matched explicitly.
The validation-trained linear logistic effect is the named predeclared non-oracle comparator; matched analytic witnesses and exact likelihood ratios are model-aware controls or ceilings.

A positive comparison flag requires both the distribution-free simultaneous confidence bound and Holm-adjusted one-sided test to pass for both preregistered middle-effect hypotheses, with the ARL guarantee intact.
A pass supports only vAOC versus the named logistic comparator on these two controlled tasks; it is not a strongest-baseline, general algorithmic-advantage, or universal sample-efficiency result.
No superiority to Helstrom, a Wilson oracle, an exact likelihood ratio, or a threshold/logistic rule on the identical sufficient statistic is claimed.

No quantum acceleration, universal sample efficiency, scalable computational advantage, new topological-order theorem, Wilson-loop discovery, string-theory result, or holographic-duality result is claimed.
design_provenance: Cycle-fair locked design frozen after the reduced pilot and independent pre-freeze audit, before the publication-grade sequential test. The audit corrected a temporal pair-versus-cycle unit error, separated every validation/training seed from locked-test seeds, and added a named validation-trained linear logistic comparator plus a multiplicity-controlled primary comparison. This comparator was chosen after inspecting the independent offline diagnostic audit but before any sequential locked test; it is predeclared here rather than claimed to be the strongest generic baseline. No publication-grade sequential result was inspected before this v2 design was frozen.
evaluation_note: Primary delays restart detectors at the changepoint on the same post-change segment. Surveillance delays are reported separately conditional on no pre-change alarm; null rows retain the ARL and censoring audit.

hypotheses.arl_basis: Both effects are fixed/predictable simplex effects centered at the analytic null; the family threshold in detector updates maps exactly to target ARL cycles.
hypotheses.descriptive_bootstrap_inferential_status: Descriptive only; not used for the comparator decision.
hypotheses.inference_assumptions: Conditional on the frozen auxiliary fits, paired test streams are independent across replicates; both restricted delays lie in [0,H], so their difference lies in [-H,H]. No symmetry or parametric assumption.
hypotheses.scope_statement: Support is limited to vAOC versus the named predeclared logistic comparator on these two controlled tasks.
